scripts.check: turbo run typecheck lint test && pnpm rules
scripts.check:affected: turbo run typecheck lint test --affected && pnpm rules
scripts.rules: depcruise packages --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && knip && node workflow-kit/checks/forbidden-terms.mjs && node scripts/db-migrations.mjs verify && node --test "scripts/*.test.mjs"
scripts.preview: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter web preview
